title: Pilatus PC-12 NGX: The Swiss Legend  (MSFS 2024) | Part 1
description:
4:2Finally, we are starting the deep-dive Pilatus PC-12 NGX Masterclass series in MSFS 2024! Today we explore the mountain-bred DNA and PT6 engine power that makes this aircraft a global legend.

We cover the exterior walkaround, the technical reasons for the T-tail design, and how the PC-12 changed aviation laws forever. If you want to master the "Flying Swiss Vault," subscribe now for next week's cockpit and avionics breakdown!
